dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Want to hear a secret? It won't come cheap. Though if you'd rather hear about how I battled a sea serpent... Well, I'll tell you that story for free.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What secret?

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: I could tell you, but, well, rules are rules — you ought to show a little goodwill so I know you're legit.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: I'll cut to the chase — no haggling — 200,000 per piece of intel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take the story, please.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Beneath the rolling waves of the boundless Forsaken Sea, there lurked a mighty beast, a colossal sea serpent that even Kratti — though troubled — was unable to best. In those days, youth was still mine to own, and I was famed throughout my homeland for my strength and valor.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Slaying the serpent was an easy task... Ah, I can still recall the warmth of its blood washing down my face, like wine at a victory feast. From that day forward, I gained the ability to understand the whisperings of animals.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: I won't lie, much of my intel comes from their words — words only I can comprehend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe next time.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Are you sure you want to turn your back on such a rare opportunity?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's too steep for me.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Ha! The price is right — if you're not willing to pay, it just means this secret isn't meant for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How would I know if it was the intel I needed?

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Ha! I see through your ruse. You're trying to trick me into revealing my intel for free. No Mora, no secret!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you trying to trick me?

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Of course not! Do you take me for one of those Frostmoon Schemers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Well, well, well! If it isn't Jahoda! Come, come. Want to hear about—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No, I don't.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: But I haven't even said anything yet! I'm not talking about sea serpents or Amrita this time, it's about—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No, I don't want to hear about it.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: My purse is shut tight, Valehti. So save your breath.

dialogues.speaker: Valehti
dialogues.text: Tch... You really don't know a good thing when you see it. But hey, no worries... I'm sure someone out there has a better eye...
